title: Design Airbnb Booking System
description: Model properties, listings, bookings, reviews, and host/guest relationships.

data.text: Design an Airbnb-like system. Hosts list properties with amenities, dates, and pricing. Guests search, book, and review stays.

data.title: Property, Booking, and Review
Why DateOnly?
data.text: Airbnb bookings are by date, not by moment. DateOnly avoids timezone bugs and makes date-range overlap checks trivial.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Property is the central listing entity
Booking links Property and Guest with a date range
Review ties to a completed Booking, not directly to Property
Search filters by location, dates, price, and amenities
data.takeaway: Airbnb is a marketplace for stays. Property, Booking, and Review are the three pillars. Search is the hardest scaling problem.
